description:
Hello everyone! We are a team of enthusiastic first-year B.Tech ECE students participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

We are interested in space, science, technology, electronics, and web development. We are beginners who are eager to learn new things, explore creative ideas, and develop innovative solutions to real-world challenges.

Skills we are looking for:

- Web development 
- Programming and software development
No need to be an expert! Beginners are also welcome.
